Module jelena.etfbl.bustraintransport
Package jelena.etfbl.simulation

Class Route

java.lang.Object
jelena.etfbl.simulation.Route
public class Route extends Object
Route represents a complete path between two cities in the transport system.

A route consists of:

  • departure â€“ the starting city,
  • destination â€“ the destination city,
  • departures â€“ the sequence of Departure legs making up the route,
  • totalPrice â€“ the sum of ticket prices for the entire route,
  • totalTime â€“ the total travel time in minutes,
  • numberOfTransfers â€“ the number of transfers (legs - 1).
